_readme: Gold set for calibrating ir-claim-auditor. Each tuple pairs a manuscript claim with the source passage it cites and the correct verdict. To calibrate: give the auditor the claim + passage (no expected_verdict), collect its verdict, and compute a confusion matrix against expected_verdict. Includes partial-support traps that must NOT be scored as VERIFIED. Verdict taxonomy: VERIFIED / MINOR_DISTORTION / MAJOR_DISTORTION / UNVERIFIABLE / UNVERIFIABLE_ACCESS.
